subject: Yoruba
topic_title: Aims and Structure of the Examination
content: The UTME 2026 Yorùbá syllabus aims to stimulate and sustain candidates' interest in Yorùbá language, literature and culture, and to test acquisition of basic knowledge and skill in the language, literature, and material/non-material aspects of culture. The examination is objective-type, with forty (40) multiple-choice questions: LANGUAGE — Comprehension (1 prose, 1 verse) 08 items, Essay writing 01 item, Sound system 04 items, Grammar 05 items, Current orthography 02 items, Translation 01 item; LITERATURE — Oral 04 items, Written 06 items; CULTURE — 09 items. Total: 40 items.
objectives: Candidates should be able to: i. demonstrate knowledge of the structure and weighting of the UTME Yorùbá examination across Language, Literature and Culture.

Total: 40 items. Candidates should be able to: i. demonstrate knowledge of the structure and weighting of the UTME Yorùbá examination across Language, Literature and Culture.

subject: Yoruba
content: Comprehension passages consist of (i) Prose and (ii) Verse.

subject: Yoruba
content: a. Production of sounds (consonants and vowels). b. Tones and tone change. c. Syllable structure. d. Sound processes: co-vowel occurrence, elision and deletion, etc.
objectives: Candidates should be able to: i. identify organs of speech, speech sounds and parameters for describing each speech sound; ii. a. determine their correct usages; ii. b. identify linguistic errors (pronunciations and wrong usages); iii. determine the syllable components of words; iv. demonstrate knowledge of the basic principles underlying the relationship between sounds.

subject: Yoruba
content: a. Morphology — Word-formation. b. Loan-word integration. c. Word classes — nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs, pronouns, conjunctions, prepositions, etc. d. Phrases and clauses — types and functions. e. Sentences — types, structures and functions.

subject: Yoruba
topic_title: Ètò Ìsìnkú àti Ogún Pínpín (Burial System and Inheritance)
content: Topics: Òkú àgbà, òkú ọ̀fọ́, òkú òòṣà, ìtúfò̀, ilẹ̀ òkú gbígbé, ídí igi, mọ̀lébí, bàbá ìsìnkú abbl (Burial of elders, mourning, burial of cult members, exhumation, burial land, family lineage matters, etc.).
objectives: Candidates should be able to: i. distinguish between traditional practices; ii. relate them to funerals and inheritance.

subject: Yoruba
content: i. Eré òṣùpa – àló, bojúbojú abbl (moonlight games — folktales/riddles, hide and seek, etc.). ii. Eré ojúmọmọ – ìjàkadì, ayò, òkòtó, àrín abbl (daytime games — wrestling, ayò game, òkòtó, àrín, etc.).
objectives: Candidates should be able to: i. identify types of Yorùbá traditional games; ii. identify rules and regulations guiding each game; iii. mention values derived from each game.
text: Eré Ìdárayá (Recreational Games). i. Eré òṣùpa – àló, bojúbojú abbl (moonlight games — folktales/riddles, hide and seek, etc.). ii. Eré ojúmọmọ – ìjàkadì, ayò, òkòtó, àrín abbl (daytime games — wrestling, ayò game, òkòtó, àrín, etc.). subject: Yoruba
topic_title: Ìṣẹ́ Àbínibí àti Oúnjẹ Ilẹ̀ Yorùbá (Traditional Occupations and Yoruba Food)
content: i. Iṣẹ́-àgbé, ìṣọ̀nà, ìlù lílù abbl (farming, carving/art, drumming, etc.). ii. Oúnjẹ - àbàrí, iyán, ẹ̀wà abbl (àbàrí, pounded yam, beans, etc.).
objectives: Candidates should be able to: i. demonstrate adequate knowledge of the various traditional professions; ii. compare various traditional professions; iii. demonstrate knowledge of preparing each type of Yorùbá food; iv. mention nutritional values of each food.
text: Ìṣẹ́ Àbínibí àti Oúnjẹ Ilẹ̀ Yorùbá (Traditional Occupations and Yoruba Food). i. Iṣẹ́-àgbé, ìṣọ̀nà, ìlù lílù abbl (farming, carving/art, drumming, etc.). ii. Oúnjẹ - àbàrí, iyán, ẹ̀wà abbl (àbàrí, pounded yam, beans, etc.). Candidates should be able to: i. demonstrate adequate knowledge of the various traditional professions; ii. compare various traditional professions; iii. demonstrate knowledge of preparing each type of Yorùbá food; iv. mention nutritional values of each food.
